quarterly_data.quarter: Nippon Sanso Holdings semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-11-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half ended September 30, 2025 (semi-annual report): group-wide product shipment volumes fell year on year; the company kept passing cost increases into selling prices (price management) and running regional productivity programs. Revenue JPY 650,829 million (+1.2%), core operating income JPY 94,257 million (+0.8%). Segment revenue / segment profit (core operating income): Japan JPY 194,698 million (-0.1%) / JPY 26,430 million (+20.2%) - gas volumes fell, but electronics equipment and construction revenue rose on progress of mid- to large-size projects; US JPY 172,586 million (-3.9%) / JPY 23,121 million (-19.1%) - electronics equipment and construction revenue declined; Europe JPY 167,939 million (+1.5%) / JPY 32,702 million (+2.7%); Asia & Oceania JPY 98,516 million (+13.8%) / JPY 8,955 million (+1.4%) - electronics equipment and construction remained firm, plus the industrial gas business acquired in Oceania this year; Thermos JPY 17,069 million (+3.8%) / JPY 3,487 million (+28.0%). H1 R&D spending JPY 2,929 million.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue JPY 650,829 million (+1.2%); core operating income JPY 94,257 million (+0.8%)
